title: Pérez 1578: Antonio Pérez to Don John of Austria, Madrid, 19 August 1578 (RAH 2/Ms Caja 8 no. 4), cipher passages read

documents.shelfmark: RAH, 2/Ms Caja 8 no. 4 (Fernández San Román collection)

places.to: Netherlands (camp of Don John of Austria)

plaintext.source: Autograph letter, plain text with four cipher passages; no contemporary decipherment found.

system.summary: Numerical syllabary: number = consonant, mark after it = vowel, superscripts = final n/s/r/l; 1577 Spanish chancery table (Genoa embassy variant)

prior_solution.where: Not in the catalogue, Cryptoole/Cryptiana, Mignet (1845), CODOIN (full text) or Avila Seoane (2024). Not checked: G. Marañón, Antonio Pérez (1947), appendices.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose the target from the catalogue and set the rules (frozen key before validation, held-out checks, prior-work search the day of publication); AI agents transcribed, solved, checked and wrote up. Doubtful signs were settled by targeted visual review where stated.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: System recognised as the 1577 Genoa embassy syllabary; key K_P = Genoa K5 + 4 values from Pérez's exploration lines.
Lexical coverage on held-out lines: not separated from controls (car3 0.764 < 0.781).
Pair AGS Estado 1410,69-70: 72.4% words / 88.5% chars (controls <= 25.3 / 55.7), under the 75% word threshold.
Fresh pair AGS Estado 1410,65-66 with K_P2 frozen: 81.3% words / 87.9% chars (controls <= 16.5 / 47.8).

outcome.method_basis: Key of a sibling cipher (1577 Genoa embassy table, rebuilt from contemporary decipherments), adapted to Pérez's variant and validated on a fresh held-out cipher / decipherment pair.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 69/70 words read in their sense; 60 certain, 9 probable, 0 restored, 1 unresolved.

credits.note: system identified, key adapted and validated on a fresh AGS pair, four passages read, English translation
credits.source: email from Brice Dudout to Daniel Bourdeau, 29 Oct 2026; merged from branch dudout/bundle-spain-italy, 30 Oct 2026

texts.label: Antonio Pérez to Don John of Austria, 19 Aug 1578, four cipher passages
texts.summary: The Council of Finance has "not a single real"; supplying what is needed is impossible; the asiento was accepted under protest that no other will be honoured.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences from Brice Dudout's reading.md and translation.md (not re-deciphered, not re-checked against the images): three of the four passages build Spanish sentences once Perez's clear text is added; one word (ningun) is left unresolved and one verb (estragar) is uncertain in sense.
